session_summary: The test run on Moon Shrine completed successfully in 12 steps, featuring 3 Slime encounters, multiple coin collections totaling 126 coins, and a successful marketplace purchase of the Trail Cap cosmetic. From an accessibility and UI perspective, actions resolved cleanly, but the current UI lacks explicit high-contrast focus rings and robust keyboard/mouse navigation cues as noted in the development backlog.

observations.evidence: Backlog item 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' notes marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus indicators for all interactive elements to support keyboard navigation and accessibility standards.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase of 'trail_cap' successfully completed, confirming coins deducted correctly and UI message displayed 'Purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins.'
observations.recommendation: Maintain clear, explicit transaction feedback messages upon marketplace purchases.

feature_requests.title: Keyboard Shortcut Indicators in UI Menus
feature_requests.player_value: Improves navigation speed and clarity for desktop players using keyboard controls.
feature_requests.rationale: Clear visual prompts for key bindings reduce cognitive load and enhance mouse/keyboard usability.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear hotkey badges next to interface buttons and marketplace actions.

keep: Clear inline feedback messages upon completing route actions and marketplace purchases.
focus: readability, button clarity, cognitive load, feedback, keyboard/mouse usability
